name: Anthony Davidson
features: fair skin, short brown hair, narrow face, very slight build, quick alert expression
bio: Toyota’s lead driver and, with Sébastien Buemi, the 2014 world champion — the title Toyota were defending in 2015 and comprehensively lost. A former Formula One driver whose LMP1 career nearly ended at Le Mans in 2012, when his car was launched over a backmarker at Mulsanne and he broke his back.
